services.desc: Enjoy fishing beautiful Lake Michigan with Captain John Wagner aboard his 33 foot Pacemaker sport fishing charter boat. Playin' Hooky Charters offers the best in Chicago fishing charters. We specialize in fishing charters on Lake Michigan, fishing for Salmon and Trout. If you're looking to catch Coho Salmon, King Salmon, Steelhead, or Rainbow Trout just come aboard the PLAYIN' HOOKY and you will enjoy some of the most exciting Illinois salmon and trout fishing on Lake Michigan. We are located close to Chicago in beautiful Waukegan Harbor and offer Chicago and its suburbs the finest in Chicago salmon fishing charters.
